source: Wikipedia tournament pages (CC BY-SA 4.0): the IIHF directorate award list, each World Junior and Olympic edition, and each Canada Cup, World Cup of Hockey and 4 Nations page

coverage.worlds: directorate awards 1954-2026 (not 2020); most valuable player from 1999
coverage.olympics: 1956-1968 from the IIHF list (they counted as World Championships); directorate awards and MVP for 2002-2018 and 2026; MVP only for 2022; none listed on Wikipedia for 1972-1998
coverage.worldcup: most valuable player only (the Canada Cup and the World Cup of Hockey have no directorate awards)
coverage.juniors: directorate awards 1977-2026 except the editions whose page lists none: 2005 (goaltender/defense/forward); most valuable player from 2004 where the page lists one
